scope: Passive research claims; not executable signals or permission for CAN transmission.

hypotheses.description: Bit changes with the recorded exterior-light ON/OFF pair; exact lamp/status meaning unconfirmed.
hypotheses.next_test: Repeat at least three cycles in another session; distinguish parking lights, manual low beam, AUTO mode without illumination, and automatic illumination. Mark actual lamp state separately from selector position.

hypotheses.description: Bit follows the same light pair; it may participate in IPC illumination state rather than encode a brightness value.
hypotheses.next_test: Separate lamp ON/OFF from brightness changes; keep lamps steady while adjusting brightness, then repeat with manual/AUTO selection.

hypotheses.description: Exploratory step has 0->1 at the light-ON marker and 1->0 at OFF, matching BH 0x354 byte 3 bit 6. This does not establish a common decoder for both buses.
hypotheses.next_test: Repeat independently and compare manual lamps, AUTO selection, actual illumination and beam/fog states.

hypotheses.description: Historical park-brake interpretation agrees with the explicit parking-brake pair about 0.8-0.9 s after markers; earlier generic brake markers also overlap transitions.
contradictions: Generic brake labels do not distinguish EPB operation from brake-pedal use; no independent actuator-state reference was captured.
hypotheses.next_test: Record pedal-only cycles with EPB unchanged, then EPB-only transitions while maintaining pedal pressure. Mark button operation and completed actuator state separately. Inspect C2 separately.

hypotheses.description: Window actions are present but no window field is identified. Raw bit steps include many unrelated candidates and mixed driver/passenger annotations.
contradictions: Event 26 describes driver-window closing and notes passenger-window opening. Only one explicitly driver-open marker; movement duration and final positions are unknown.
hypotheses.next_test: Stationary: driver down/up three times, then passenger down/up separately. Mark switch press, release and full-open/full-closed states; keep other controls and ignition steady.

hypotheses.description: Constant prefix 00 00 00 20 60 00 followed by a 4-bit rolling counter (byte 6, modulus 16) and its check byte (byte 7). Carries no payload state; candidate bits on it are phase artefacts (bundle top hits are here).
hypotheses.next_test: Exclude byte 6 and byte 7 from candidate scoring on low-rate frames; confirm the modulus over a long baseline.

hypotheses.description: Constant prefix 80 00 followed by a 4-bit rolling counter (byte 2) and a check byte (byte 3). Carries no payload state.
Bytes 6-7 are a 4-bit counter and its check byte; bytes 0-5 carry drive-mode state. Only byte 6/7 candidates are spurious.

Bytes 0-3 hold two 16-bit values that decrease monotonically and bytes 4-7 are constant (ff ff 00 00); it may be an accumulator/heartbeat rather than instantaneous state, which would make its window/seat-belt/mirror/suspension candidates drift.
contradictions: Automatic bit-step ranking shows moderate window/seat-belt/mirror/suspension agreement, but the field trend is monotonic.
hypotheses.next_test: Sample 0x341 over a quiet idle baseline and over a long steady interval; confirm whether the fields are time counters before accepting any state bit.

hypotheses.description: Closure/ajar status on the 10 ms backbone, gateway-duplicated on C2: boot at byte 2 bit 2 (active-low), bonnet at byte 3 bit 1 (active-low). Byte 6 is a counter and byte 7 a CRC.
contradictions: Single session; closure bits and other byte 0-3 activity are not yet separated.
hypotheses.next_test: Repeat boot-only and bonnet-only cycles and confirm the active-low sense with negative controls.

hypotheses.description: BH-side companion of 0x116; boot at byte 2 bit 2 follows the same open/closed sense.
hypotheses.next_test: Confirm it is the same body state as 0x116 in a repeated session.

hypotheses.description: Lock/door status byte: byte 3 carries 128 distinct values and its bits 2-6 follow lock/unlock; byte 6 is a counter and byte 7 a CRC.
hypotheses.next_test: Isolate lock, unlock and per-door open/close with the door warning marker.

hypotheses.description: High-volume backbone frame whose byte 0 takes single-bit values (0x20/0x40/0x80), suggesting a one-hot lamp/indicator flag; byte 7 is a CRC. The individual lamp was not isolated.
contradictions: Steady dipped/high/fog lamps produced no clean level bit; a pulse/one-hot encoding is plausible.
hypotheses.next_test: Activate one lamp at a time and read byte 0 raw values; keep lamps steady for several seconds.

hypotheses.description: Brake state lead on the 10 ms backbone: byte 2 bit 6 rises with the brake-pedal marker (ON 0.66 / OFF 0.01); 0x100 byte 0 also follows. Distinct from the 0x384 park-brake comment.
hypotheses.next_test: Pedal-only cycles with EPB unchanged, then EPB-only cycles with pedal held.

hypotheses.description: Byte 0 bit 4 rises with engine start and clears on stop (ON 0.83 / OFF 0.01). Conflicts with the existing reference-only note that calls 0x1FC active damping; both meanings may coexist on one multiplexed frame.
contradictions: Prior reference-only interpretation: active damping / differential status.
hypotheses.next_test: Repeat start/stop cycles and inspect the full payload to separate engine-running from the damping reference.

hypotheses.description: Comfort status: wipers at byte 4 bit 4 (ON 0.92 / OFF 0.29); a first wiper lead. Companion climate leads: BH 0x46A and C1 0x736 follow front defrost/fan.
contradictions: Rain sensor / wiper strokes were previously an explicit gap; this is a lead, not a decoder.
hypotheses.next_test: Run the rain/wipers procedures alone with each wiper speed isolated and the washer separated.
